items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I had Herbie Jones on trumpet.

ctx.x: He got an idea to recreate a Cotton Club show on the beach in Miami. So he contacted Cab, and Cab told him to get in touch with me. So he got in touch with me. And we got together to put a band together for this show and get the music together. So I became the musical director.
We used -- let's see, we used three trumpets, one trombone and four saxes and three rhythms. In fact, I had Herbie Jones on trumpet. Who were the --
(Inaudible) Cotton Club Review with dancers and --
